metadata.description: Gmail attachment download skill — bridges the gmail-mcp body-only gap so any Claude environment can read PDF/image/docx/xlsx attachments.

plugins.name: gmail-attachments
plugins.description: Download and read Gmail file attachments (PDF, image, CSV, docx, xlsx, etc.). Works on local Mac via ~/.gmail-mcp/ files, or remote VMs (Cowork, CI) via GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN env vars.
